adjudication.rationale: Looking at the embed_controller.rb code at line 15, when topic_id is nil, it enqueues a job with `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)`. The TopicRetriever class does have throttling via `retrieved_recently?` which uses Redis setnx with a 60-second expiry, but this throttling happens INSIDE the job worker (in `perform_retrieve`), not before the job is enqueued. This means if multiple requests come in simultaneously for the same embed_url before any job starts processing, multiple jobs will be enqueued to the queue. The deduplication only prevents the actual HTTP fetch, but the jobs are still queued. This is a valid concern about queue flooding during traffic bursts.
